selection.description: The interview assesses academic qualifications, English and motivation for study.

Applications received by 15 March are also assessed on upper-secondary exam results, work experience, relevant courses and other documented qualifications. Places split 65 per cent quota 1 and 35 per cent quota 2.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a diplomingeniør programme at a university college, which is a professionsbachelor programme: Absalon lists the programme on its Danish page as a professionsbachelor ("Professionsbachelor — Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi"). The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

requirements.label: Physics at B level or Geoscience at A level
Chemistry at B level or Biotechnology at A level
An admission interview (every quota 2 applicant, including IB applicants)

officialWording.text: All quota 2 applicants, including applicants with a foreign or international upper secondary qualification, must attend an admission interview to be eligible for admission to the programme.

officialRequirementsText.text: Mathematics equivalent to a Danish A-level and Physics equivalent to a Danish B-level or Geoscience equivalent to a Danish A-level and Chemistry equivalent to a Danish B-level or Biotechnology equivalent to a Danish A-level and English equivalent to Danish B-level.

notes: Absalon does not state the length of the programme on the pages read, so none is recorded here.

An English test (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL) can only replace English B for applicants without a qualifying English level. Absalon also takes an Online Mathematics Placement Test into account when it assesses applicants individually.
